Name: New NPC Figg 1.6
Author: muxuelaiyin
Description:
你好，这里是弗格的非官方1.6更新，已经获得原作者的授权。这里是原MOD链接：[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6819]NPC Figg[/url]。

介绍：
弗格是一位来自祖祖城的心理医生，他厌恶JOJA，于是坐着火车来到了星露谷。他住在哈维的诊所里，帮助鹈鹕镇上的村民调节心理健康。

礼物：
最爱：金南瓜、兔子脚、五彩碎片、珍珠、魔法糖冰棍、彩虹贝壳、蜂蜜、水晶果
喜欢；花、能量补水、雪山药、咖啡、珊瑚、草莓
普通：腌菜、粘土、美洲树莓、蕨菜
讨厌：辣椒（包括辣椒料理）酒、蒜

事件：
2：星期天，9：00-11：00，诊所。
4：不是星期四，8：00-12：00，诊所。
6：星期二，与谢恩2心，13：00-16：00，玛妮的家。
8：星期五，17：00-21：00，火车站。
9：不是星期一、星期天，13：00-16：00，图书馆。
10：21：00-24：00，火车站。

PS：
1.高清肖像在本体文件中，需要[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]作为前置，自行搜索使用方法。
2.有问题请在这里留言或者XHS找我，我看到有空就会修，但请描述得详细一点，因为我比较菜。
3.现在应该与几乎所有MOD兼容，如果发现冲突，请向我报告，我很乐意为他制作补丁。
4.如果你喜欢这个MOD，请在下载完成15分钟后回到主界面为我点个赞，拜托拜托。

——————————————————————————————————————————————————————————

English translation :[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29068]New NPC Figg (english translation)[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/94286373]ruunyastardew[/url] .

Introduction:
Figg is a psychologist from Zuzu City who hates JOJA, so he took a train to Stardew Valley. He lives in Harvey's clinic and helps the villagers in Pelican Town regulate their mental health.

Gift:
Love: Golden pumpkin, rabbit feet, colorful fragments, pearls, magic sugar popsicle, rainbow shell, honey, crystal fruit
like: Flowers, energy supplement, snow yam, coffee, coral, strawberry
Neutral: pickles, clay, raspberries, ferns
Hate: chili (including chili cuisine) wine, garlic

Hearts Events:
2: Sunday, 9:00-11:00, Hosptial.
4: Not Thursday, 8:00-12:00, Hosptial.
6: Tuesday, 2 hearts with Shane,13:00-16:00, Animal Shop.
8: Friday, 17:00-21:00,Railroad.
9: Not Monday and Sunday, 13:00-16:00,ArchaeologyHouse.
10: 21:00-24:00,Railroad.

PS:
1. Figg's high-definition portrait is placed in the "高清肖像" folder named in Chinese,need to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] .
2. If you have any questions, please leave a message here or contact me on XHS. I will fix them when I have time, but please describe them in more detail
because I am a bit inexperienced.
3. It should be compatible with all mods now. If you find any conflicts, please let me know and I will be happy to make patches for it.
4.  If you like this mod, please give me a like on the main interface after downloading it, please.
5. Anyone who wants to translate this mod into other languages is welcome, and I would be extremely grateful.
